data.body:
IMPORTANT CORRECTION — my Bedrock measurements were taken in a DIFFERENT AWS ACCOUNT AND REGION than this project's infrastructure. I did not check this before recording them as findings, and the operator caught it.

WHERE I MEASURED: account 5797...98, region us-east-2, IAM user joe_sec (profile "frontier"), which holds AmazonBedrockFullAccess (bedrock:*).

WHERE THIS PROJECT RUNS: account 896586841071 — evidenced by the terraform S3 backend bucket "rebar-tfstate-896586841071" (infra/terraform/versions.tf:14) and infra/terraform/iam_s4a.tf:14 — in region us-east-1 (the aws_region default in infra/terraform/variables.tf:1-5). That is where the rebar-gerrit-instance-role and the review bot live, and therefore where stories 9249 (S7) and eb6e (S8) operate.

WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT INVALIDATE:

LIKELY ACCOUNT/REGION-SCOPED — must be RE-MEASURED in 896586841071 / us-east-1 before being relied on:
- "Plain on-demand model ids are not invokable at all." Bedrock model access is enabled per account AND per region, so this is plausibly a property of MY account's configuration rather than a universal AWS fact. If on-demand ids DO work in the project account, the inference-profile-only conclusion (and therefore the default model id) is weaker than I stated.
- "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 caches (cache_write=4017 then cache_read=4017)." Model access AND inference-profile availability are per account/region. DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID as shipped may not even be ENABLED in the project account — that must be verified before S8 cuts the production bot over to it with no fallback.
- "us. and global. opus-4-5 silently do not cache." Same caveat.

LIKELY GENERALIZES, but should still be confirmed:
- "temperature is fatal on us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 (400: deprecated for this model)." This reads as a model-level API property rather than an account-scoped one, and the pydantic-ai asymmetry behind it is a code fact, not an AWS fact: _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings exists only in models/anthropic.py, not models/bedrock.py. The supports_temperature mechanism this story added is therefore still correct and still needed regardless of account.

WHAT IS UNAFFECTED: everything verified in-repo rather than against AWS — the capability layer, the exact-id override table, the cache-ineffectiveness warning predicate, the sampling-parameter error translation, the [bedrock]/dev extra split, and the full gating suite result (7538 passed) plus change 1043's LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1. The live canary DID pass against real Bedrock, so the code path works; what is now uncertain is whether the specific MODEL IDS behave the same way in the project account.

ACTION REQUIRED, and it belongs to the stories that have the right credentials: story 0d76 (S6, the parity bar) and story 9249 (S7) must re-run the cache probe in 896586841071 / us-east-1 and confirm (a) which model ids are invokable there, (b) that DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID is enabled and caches there, before eb6e (S8) cuts production over with no Anthropic fallback. The probe script used here is reusable: /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/jobs/4ca991d2/tmp/bedrock_cache_probe.py (parameterise CANDIDATES and REGION).
